snippet.title: Virtual World Red Planet 3.0 Dooley Trainer
snippet.description: This was the classic Virtual World system 3.0 Red Planet trainer featuring an extensive list of celebs including Joan Severance, Judge Reinhold, Nora Dunn, Cheech Marin, Wierd Al, and more!
